## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/verify.mjs --static` passes
- [ ] `node scripts/sync.mjs` then `node scripts/verify.mjs` pass against a running Herdr
- [ ] Screenshot attached (or: no visible change)
- [ ] No official art, logos or images other than `preview.png`
- [ ] No personal data: paths with your user name, emails, session ids, terminal text
- [ ] `RECIPE.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the behaviour changed
